title: Shipped Python file core/go_host.py carried a UTF-8 BOM (change-scoped gate fail-closed)
body: core/go_host.py had a UTF-8 BOM; Python 3 tolerates it at import but the language-rule gate parses changed shipped files as plain UTF-8 and fails closed.

rcca.root_cause: core/go_host.py was authored with a UTF-8 BOM; the change-scoped language-rule gate parses changed shipped files as plain UTF-8, so the BOM reads as U+FEFF and fails.
rcca.corrective: Stripped the BOM from core/go_host.py; recorded a BOM sweep for the remaining shipped tree.
rcca.preventive: Gate can read shipped files as utf-8-sig (behavior-preserving) OR the tree stays BOM-free; new files must be BOM-free.
